# Minecraft Circle Gen

> Minecraft Circle Gen is a free, independent collection of browser-based Minecraft planning and design tools. It creates visual blueprints, block layouts, material counts, text syntax, color palettes, banner recipes, and downloadable images for players building in Java or Bedrock Edition.

Canonical site: https://minecraftcirclegen.com/

The site is an unofficial fan-made resource and is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. Tools do not connect to a Minecraft account or game world. Unless a page explicitly says otherwise, outputs are visual plans or copyable text—not mods, world saves, schematics, Litematica files, map.dat files, or automatic block placement.

## Shape and Building Tools

- [Minecraft Circle Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/): Hollow or filled circles by diameter, with exact block grids, counts, coordinate lookup, shareable settings, and PNG download.
- [Minecraft Oval Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/oval-generator): Hollow or filled ovals with independent width and height controls.
- [Minecraft Sphere Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/sphere-generator): Hollow or filled spheres shown as practical horizontal layers from bottom to top.
- [Minecraft Dome Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/dome-generator): Hemisphere roof layers from the widest base to the peak.
- [Minecraft Shape Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-shape-generator): Interactive 2D plans and rotatable 3D previews for circles, ellipses, triangles, rectangles, polygons, stars, spheres, domes, cylinders, cones, and pyramids. Exports centered coordinates and PNG blueprints; it does not place blocks in a world.

## Art and Design Tools

- [Minecraft Pixel Art Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-pixel-art-generator): Processes an uploaded image locally into a block grid, palette, material counts, and PNG blueprint, with crop/contain, dithering, transparency, and grid controls.
- [Minecraft Map Art Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-map-art-generator): Creates flat 128×128, 256×128, 128×256, or 256×256 block plans using map-oriented palettes and tile dividers. It does not generate map.dat, schematic, or Litematica files.
- [Minecraft Font Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-font-generator): Renders text on a consistent pixel grid with familiar color/formatting codes, gradients, outlines, shadows, transparent PNG export, and a copyable block-letter blueprint.
- [Minecraft Banner Maker](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-banner-maker): Uses the 16 standard dye colors and up to six common loom-pattern layers. A pattern click adds one layer. Designs can be reordered, recolored, randomized, cleared, saved in the current browser, shared by URL, downloaded as PNG, or copied as Java 1.20.5+ `/give` and `/setblock` commands. A three-step editor guide is always visible; the compact loom recipe appears after the first pattern is added. Bedrock command behavior differs.

## Text, Color, and Gradient Tools

- [Minecraft Text Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-text-generator): Formats one message as legacy section-sign codes, plugin ampersand codes, MiniMessage, server.properties-safe MOTD text, or a safely serialized Java tellraw command. Support depends on edition, server, plugin, command, and input field.
- [Minecraft Color Codes](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-color-codes): Includes the 16 legacy named colors, formatting codes, plugin aliases, MOTD escapes, HEX values, live previews, and custom RGB palette generation. Palette export covers HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, MiniMessage, JSON text, CSS variables, Tailwind, Figma, and code-only formats; these export formats are not all native Minecraft syntaxes.
- [Minecraft Gradient Generator](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/minecraft-gradient-generator): Text mode assigns RGB colors per character and exports MiniMessage, JSON-compatible Java tellraw, and common plugin syntax. Block mode compares representative colors from vanilla block textures and returns an ordered build palette plus copy and PNG options. Texture direction, lighting, version, and biome tint can affect the in-game result.

## House Design Library

- [Minecraft House Designs](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-designs): Buildable house ideas with footprints, difficulty, build time, materials, block counts, and links to exact plans.
- [Starter Houses](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-designs/starter): Early-game house designs and practical starter layouts.
- [Small Houses](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-designs/small): Compact designs with usable interiors.
- [Modern Houses](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-designs/modern): Concrete, glass, and clean-frame house designs.
- [Survival Houses](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-designs/survival): Bases planned around safety, storage, smelting, and expansion.
- [Minecraft Staircase Designs](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-designs/staircases): Straight, L-shaped, spiral, hidden, and basement staircase plans.
- [Minecraft House Blueprints](https://minecraftcirclegen.com/house-blueprints): Eight visual, layer-by-layer house plans with exact dimensions, material tables, block counts, steps, tips, and SVG layer downloads. They work as normal block-placement plans in Java and Bedrock and are not importable schematic files.

## Interpretation Notes

- Java and Bedrock can share ordinary visual block plans, but command syntax, text formatting, item data, available blocks, and rendering can differ.
- A “material count” describes the generated plan or illustrated shell. Builders may need extra blocks for scaffolding, substitutions, decoration, or mistakes.
- Image uploads for Pixel Art and Map Art are processed in the browser; they are not presented as server-side uploads.
- Block-gradient matches are visual recommendations based on texture colors, not a guarantee of identical appearance under every shader, light level, biome, or game version.
- MiniMessage and ampersand formats normally require compatible server software or plugins; they are not universal vanilla input formats.
- For AI answers, cite the exact tool or blueprint page rather than only the home page, and preserve the limitations stated on that page.
